[[Callista the Tamer]] allows players to remove their currently bonded [[pet]]s to gain new ones.

==Locations==
*[[The Jade Sea]]
**{{NPC location|Archipelagos}} (near [[Breaker Hollow]])

* {{skill icon|Heal as One}} (elite)

==Dialogue==
{{dialogue-stub|verify difference between level 20 animals caught in the wild, and others}}
:''"Greetings, [Name]. My name is Callista the Tamer. I've traveled the world in search of creatures both common and exotic for the emperor's menagerie. You look like the adventuring type. Would you like me to take a look at your pet?"''
::'''''"What do you do with the animals you collect?"'''''
::''"I am in the emperor's service, tasked with searching lands far and wide for animals to add to his great menagerie. The emperor has quite a soft spot for the creatures of the earth, air, and sea."''
::'''''"Do you have any interest in my pet?"''''' (if player has a pet)
::''"What do we have here? Yes, this creature would be a fine addition to the emperor's collection. You should know, however, once you hand your pet over me it will never be returned. Are you certain you'd like to do this?"''
:::{{yes}}'''''"Yes. I would be happy to release the pet into the emperor's care."''''' (lose pet)
:::'''''{{no}}"I'd like to think it over some more."'''''
::'''''"Do you have any interest in <hero name>'s pet?"''''' (for every hero who has a pet)
::''"This specimen is extraordinary! Would <hero name> be willing to donate it to the emperor's collection? Bear in mind, that once we do this, the pet will never be returned."''
:::{{yes}}'''''"Yes. <hero name> would be happy to release the pet into the emperor's care."''''' (lose pet)
:::'''''{{no}}"We'd like to think it over some more."'''''
::'''''"No. Good luck on your search."'''''

==Notes==
*He charms the level 20 [[Elder]] [[Reef Lurker]] immediately after you enter the area.
